name: Injuu Kunoichi ~Chuugi o Koeru Reizoku~
original_name: 淫従くノ一 ～忠義を超える隷属～
source:
In the [i]Edo[/i] period───.

A [i]daimyo[/i] and the governor of Nagasa District "Shibata Samon", joins forces with "Daikokuya Rihei" in committing evil deeds, spending their days with their pockets filled.

But one day, they hear the news that a spy may have been sent to investigate them. Is the spy an official, or perhaps from someone who is jealous of Samon's wealth and trying to bring him down.

If there is a spy among the people, then they ought to catch them and teach them a lesson───.

"───[i]Odaikan[/i]-sama, how about setting a trap here?"

"Are you trying to lure out the spy?"

"Yes, my lord───Rather than hiding carelessly, if we do our evil deeds openly, then the spy will definitely come out."

"That's true... We'll just have to keep a tight net and make sure they can't get away."

"It would be nice to recruit the spy as well───And to do that, of course, if you can spare me your funds."

"Fufufu, very well───You're so evil, Daikokuya."

"No, not at all, not as much as you, [i]odaikan[/i]-sama... Fufufu───"

Thus, to protect themselves, Samon and Rihei carry out their plan immediately.

[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1256232&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
在[i]Edo[/i]时期──。

[i]大名[/i]与长笠郡知事“柴田左门”，与“大黑屋利兵卫”联手作恶，过着中饱私囊的日子。

但有一天，他们听到消息称一名间谍可能被派来调查他们。这名间谍是官员，还是嫉妒萨蒙财富并试图打倒他的人。

如果民间有奸细，就应该抓起来教训一下──。

“────[i]大官[/i]大人，在这里设个陷阱怎么样？”

“你是想引诱间谍吗？”

“是的，大人──与其大意地躲起来，不如公开做坏事，间谍一定会现身的。”

“确实如此……我们只需要拉紧网，确保他们无法逃脱。”

“招募间谍也不错啊──当然，如果你能把资金留给我的话。”

“呼呼呼，很好──大黑屋你真是太邪恶了。”

“不，一点也不，没有你[i]odaikan[/i]大人……呼呼呼──”

因此，为了保护自己，萨蒙和利平立即实施了他们的计划。

[编译自[url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1256232&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
